Market today: Tech is still the driver, but the mood is cautious. Headlines about AI talks and mortgage rates are the main noise, but nothing directly moves chip names today.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.8%) and SPAL (-34.45%) are the big red flags. They are leveraged ETFs and are bleeding on margin. CRWD (46.4%) and METU (52.58%) are your winners, but watch them.

Watch: The general market indices (SPY, QQQ) and the semiconductor ETF (SMH) for direction. Also, keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs' decay.

Bottom line: Manage your risk on the leveraged names; they are the most vulnerable right now.
plays: SOXL/SPAL: Consider trimming these leveraged ETFs if they continue to drop. Margin calls are a real risk.
CRWD: If it breaks below its stop at 147.5, consider taking profits. It's a big winner.
No new buys today - hold and watch
